label: PoE 1 3.30
notes: First 3.30 publication, extracted from client 3.30.0.2.2. It applies the 3.30.0 rules prepared in r17: recombination keeps the chosen base's item level and counts only modifiers legal on it, Orb of Annulment ignores Cannot roll Attack or Caster Modifiers, Incursion glove suffixes are no longer offered, and vendor recipes follow the patch notes. Harvest crafts charge every lifeforce type the client lists, including Crystallised Rancour. Bench metamods have one modifier per item-class group, each with its own cost. The new 1 or 2 Prefix or Suffix Modifiers cannot be changed crafts are refused until their protection is modelled, and the Locus of Corruption does not yet corrupt an item a second time. Projects on the 3.29 era keep r17 and its catalog.

label: PoE 2 (client 4.5)
notes: Publishes the shared implementation changes made for the PoE 1 3.30 era, with no change to PoE 2 crafting mechanics or its catalog. Revisions r1 through r17 retain their original immutable engines and behavior; equipment prices remain manual.
